2226497419.annotation: One of the few 6.4k gun items is good for Seven. Shred with Crippling or Rend is better to pick up as it multiplies your damage though.

1193964439.annotation: This is okay for ult and stun, ball too of course. If you have Ballistic Enchantment on ball you don't really need this, it can be a luxury replacement end game.

1797283378.annotation: A huge amount of lifesteal and damage output on command. Check Leech for more info.

4075861416.annotation: A cheap way of getting a ton of spirit shred. Good replacement for Crippling Headshot if you can't afford it or are less confident in your aim.

1813726886.annotation: There are a LOT of heroes this is disgusting against. If this is good, get instead of Suppressor. Don't sleep on this!

3140772621.annotation: Decent against gun AND melee damage. Consider Plated Armor or Metal Skin instead.

915014646.annotation: Cooldown *can* replace Duration. The difference is small but duration is better for ball, and effects items without 6.4k. Feel free to try cooldown, especially with a lot of items with a cooldown.

2064029594.annotation: PRIO WHEN YOU DONT NEED ANTI-HEAL OR FIRE RATE DOWN

968099481.annotation: IF YOU NEED TO BUY AND HAVE SPARE SOULS ITS NICE TO GRAB THIS

1292979587.annotation: VERY IMPORTANT YOU PLAY AROUND THIS COOLDOWN TRY TO AVOID USING SURGE FOR THINGS YOU DONT NEED TILL YOU HAVE SUP DURA

3970837787.annotation: Experimenting with this for more damage early instead of lifesteal. Feel free to swap back if you want, get Healbane first if required.

1235347618.annotation: // Anti Gun \\ ---> Haze, Venator, Warden, and if any hero also goes gun when their main build isn't gun, Grey Talon, Paige,Ivy Ect

1644605047.annotation: VERY good for laning against CC heavy heroes.

1047818222.annotation: // Anti Stuns And Debuffs \\ Makes You Able To Parry Venator Stun, Decreases Shiv knife, Infernus burn & many more debuffs duration, --> Upgrades Into Spellbreaker (Situational) And Unstoppable (Core)

2829638276.annotation: Can replace with your preferred survivability (Healing Rite, Extra HP etc) but I like staying in lane. Just got buffed!

1152158042.annotation: Mostly troll pickup but sometimes you never want to sell Slowing Hex so might as well upgrade it and get bonus range too!

2533252781.annotation: If you are getting dived a lot this might buy you valuable seconds for your team to help. Big buff after too!

393974127.annotation: A lot less damage but more utility, can upgrade to Weighted which is.. interesting. Can replace your 1.6k weapon slot.

1144549437.annotation: Late game focused pickup for a bit of spirit resist shred and lifesteal, but less early weapon damage. Can replace your 1.6k weapon slot.

3294954488.annotation: Consistent damage and that extra bit of range. Can take instead of Cultist for less greed, or instead of Opening Rounds for MEGA greed.

2037039379.annotation: Procs with 2 bursts, Seems Really Good For A Cancer Gun Type build, 25% weapon dmg is also big!, needs more testing though and where it fits

1282141666.annotation: // Anti Tank \\ --> 2.5 HP% steal, Good against high health heroes, Victor, Mo, Abrams, Shiv ECT [Sell Toxic If Heavily Slot Locked]

805079544.annotation: // Anti Gun \\ Shotguns and Melees like Venator And Abrams But Reactive Might Be Better

1710079648.annotation: More healing than Regen, use when you like running boxes a lot, or if you are desparately low on HP.

787198704.annotation: Charges and CDR on Balls is really nice, don't have to stress about using them all up as much. If you have 6.4k, get Boundless or EE first.

3270001687.annotation: Positioning is SUPER important. You are a fragile backliner, this helps you stay that way!

493591231.annotation: The slow is decent, but basically impossible to fit. The scroll upgrade here does literally nothing unless you ult, which is not ideal in the first place.

2739107182.annotation: don't let me try this again

710436191.annotation: needs a ton of aim and patience with no wraith ult (wraith's buy it the most), you could use it after stun but just get other stuff

3399065363.annotation: Prerequisite to Enduring Speed. A nice bit of regen and speed for box runs. Take later if not feeding.

84321454.annotation: Mid item on its own, but Magnum makes it worth. Helps with ammo.

754480263.annotation: Mostly a meme pickup, hard to justify the slot for unless you are ahead on slots really early.

1763073141.annotation: If you run out of ball charges, try this. Though usually, that means you are using them wastefully! Can replace your 1.6k weapon slot.
